Although memory costs are expected to easily become the single largest item in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the situation for the iPhone Duo may not be the same. Here are the details.

Apple signs three-year exclusive display supply deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple and Samsung Display have signed an exclusive supply deal for foldable panels lasting three years.

According to this leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successor models", with each panel costing about US$250.

The leaker also pointed out that the panel is, unsurprisingly, "one of the most expensive core components" of the device.

Although there are currently no reliable reports detailing the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo, Apple has shared some interesting information about its material content—including how much of it is recycled material—and has broken it down by the cost share of display, camera, processor, memory and other components.

From the iPhone Duo press release:

As for the actual bill of materials of the device, teardown reports and other analyses after it officially goes on sale next month will give us a clearer picture.
